title: fix(auth)!: a server outside development mode refuses a development seed credential
body:
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不在开发模式（`NODE_ENV` 不是 `development`）的服务器不再接受开发种子凭据：用开发种子密码（`admin123`，或 `OS_SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` 的值）登录一律拒绝；`os dev` 种出的管理员和 `demoStaff` 账号（只有走种子自身开通票据的创建）带种子标记，管理员建的账号不带，密码仍是种子密码时任何登录方式都不开会话。新增 `os user set-password EMAIL`，在服务器上直接改密码，拒绝提示里点名它。本 PR 只落裁决第 1、2 项。
- 为什么改：维护者裁决（选项 A）：不在开发模式的服务器永不接受开发种子凭据；拒绝放在 plugin-auth，`os start`、`os serve`、镜像与自定义宿主一并覆盖。维护者续裁：「已经开发完的要继续跟进到合并」「只合前两项：第三项另开一张跟进卡。」
- 风险与回滚：生产模式下凡是密码等于开发种子密码的账号都登不进去，需运维用新命令改密；开发模式不变。离开开发模式前已签发的会话与 API key 由 `os user set-password` 结束，开机时结束它们是 #35184。生产模式每次建会话多一次 `sys_user` 读。回滚即 revert 本 PR（新列留空无害）。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/dev-seed-credential.ts`（三条拒绝与种子标记）、`auth-manager-membership-admission.ts`（种子标记只在种子开通票据被证实时暂存）、`operator-password-reset.ts`（改密：先清掉该账号未用的重置令牌，再写密码、撤会话与 API key）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/dev-seed-credential-production.test.ts`，应见 13 个用例全绿（含管理员建号对照组：开发模式建、生产模式能登录）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（a security item is with the owner seat）。

## What changes

**The rule: a server that is not in development mode never accepts a development seed credential.** Development mode is `NODE_ENV=development`, the condition the development seed itself runs under. The rule lives in `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, so `os start`, `os serve`, the image and a custom host all apply it. This PR lands ruling items 1 and 2.

- **The seed password is refused at sign-in, on any account** (`refuseDevSeedPasswordSignIn`, first in the global `hooks.before`). A password sign-in (`/sign-in/email`, `/sign-in/username`, `/sign-in/phone-number`) that submits the development seed password (`admin123`, or the value `OS_SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` sets) answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with a sentence naming `os user set-password EMAIL`. It is decided on the submitted password alone, so every address gets the same answer.
- **The verifier never accepts a seed credential** (`withDevSeedPasswordRefusal`, wrapping the pair handed to `emailAndPassword.password`): a seed password, or the hash a marked account still holds from the seed, is answered as a wrong password on every door that checks a password.
- **The seed mark.** `sys_user.dev_seed_credential` (new, `internal`, `readonly`, indexed, translated in all locales) holds a SHA-256 digest of the password hash the seed stored, never the password. It is staged by the audience gate only for a creation that proved the development seed's own provisioning ticket for its address (`os dev`'s admin, each `demoStaff` account), never for the wider operator class (an administrator's create-user, a bulk import, directory provisioning), and written in `account.create.after`, in development only. Any password change stops it matching.
- **A marked account still on its seed password opens no session** (`refuseDevSeedCredentialSession`, in `session.create.before`), on every door: password, emailed link, one-time code, passkey, social or SSO, impersonation and a minted session. The answer is `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` naming the reset command; a read that fails answers `503`, as the sibling refusals do.
- **No forced change at sign-in.** No refusal opens a session in which the password could be changed.
- **`os user set-password EMAIL`** (new `user` topic). It resolves the account first, reads the password from an unechoed prompt (twice) or `--password-stdin`, never from argv. plugin-auth's `setOperatorPassword` checks exactly two things about the new password, that it is not a seed password and that it is 8 to 128 characters (the deployment's own password policy and history are not applied), refuses an account with no password credential, deletes the account's outstanding password-reset rows before the new password lands (the rule every password door keeps, `credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.ts`), writes better-auth's own hash, clears the mark and any sign-in lock, stamps `password_changed_at`, and ends every session and revokes every API key of the account (`revokeSessionsAndApiKeys`). It sets no forced change. It writes the project database only: a host secondary storage is out of its reach for reset links and sessions alike, and the docs give the remedy (run it with the server stopped, or restart the server afterwards).
- Docs: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (the command), `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` (the rule). Changeset: `.changeset/dev-seed-credential-production-refusal.md` (BREAKING banner, `Clause-②`, ADR-0087 `not-required` marker naming the added system column). Both the changeset and `self-hosting.mdx` state the release's present limit: sessions and API keys a seeded account was issued before the server left development mode are ended by `os user set-password`, and ending them at boot is follow-up #35184.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/dev-seed-credential-production.test.ts` (13; real `ObjectKernel` + ObjectQL on SQLite + `AuthPlugin` with one `demoStaff` entry + `SecurityPlugin`, seeded in development, then served by a second `AuthManager` outside development): development control; an account an administrator creates in development (better-auth `createUser`, as `/admin/create-user` drives it) carries no mark while the seed's accounts on the same boot do, and it signs in outside development mode; the mark is a digest and never served; the seed admin refused 403 with the command and no session; a demo account refused; the phone-number password sign-in refused; an unknown address answered identically; an unmarked account on the seed password refused; a marked account on a custom seed password answered as a wrong password with no session; the emailed sign-in link opens no session for it; after `setOperatorPassword` the new password signs in, the mark is gone and the development session is ended; the reset ends the account's outstanding reset links and no other account's; the reset's refusals write nothing.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/dev-seed-credential.test.ts` (7, unit): the seed password set, the sign-in refusal's doors and development passthrough, the verifier's answers. `/sign-in/username` stays in the refused set but has no real-pipeline case: the platform's own composition serves no username plugin.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/user/set-password.integration.test.ts` (3, real SQLite file through oclif): sets the password from stdin in the format a server verifies and ends the session and the API key; refuses the seed password and writes nothing; refuses an unknown address before asking.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.one-shot-family.integration.test.ts`: the command joins the one-shot family.
- `packages/cli/test/dev-start-shared-data-key.integration.test.ts`: the fixture serves an `os dev` database under `os start`, so it now runs `os user set-password` between the two boots and signs in with the password it set. Its assertions are unchanged.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/colleague-lookup-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`: the directory set leaves out an `internal` column served to nobody.

## Acceptance notes

- Ruling item 3 is follow-up card #35184; this PR lands items 1–2.
- `origin/main` merged at `4b1eb0eab7` (220 first-parent commits). Conflicts: `auth-manager-membership-admission.ts` kept both sides (the seed mark staging, then main's invitation-admission staging); the two tenant-audit census files took main's version and the plugin-auth shard was regenerated with `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`.
- After the merge, `setOperatorPassword` also keeps main's rule that a password set ends the account's outstanding reset tokens. It deletes the rows in the project database before the write; a host `secondaryStorage` is not reachable from the CLI, the same reach as the raw adapter (`createObjectQLAdapter`), and the docs and changeset state that reach.
- A database seeded before this release with a custom seed password carries no mark and is not detected; the changeset says so.
